global_invariants.zero_lake: Never invoke lake (lake build/env/exe/test/clean/update). Build exclusively via python3 scripts/build_turbo.py --direct-lean or python3 scripts/build_turbo.py with LEAN_PATH=.lake/build/lib/lean:../lean-sys/.lake/build/lib/lean and TURBO_LEAN_EMIT_C=1.
global_invariants.zero_sorry_axioms: 0 sorryAx and 0 custom axioms across all LeanAV.* declarations ({propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} only).
global_invariants.tight_specs: Every AVGateSpec in edited modules must pass turbo-lean --json audit-spec with 0 vacuous, 0 trivial, 0 shadowed.
global_invariants.zero_subprocess: 0 child process spawns (no ffmpeg/ffprobe execve in Lean or C).
global_invariants.signed_commits: GPG-sign commits (git commit -S), never amend, never force-push, never use [skip ci].

planar_u16le.gbrp10le: Planar G, B, R order (FFmpeg GBRP10LE), each plane 2*w*h LE u16 in [0,1023]

semi_planar_and_packed_u16le.p010le: Y plane 2*w*h LE u16 (sample10 <<< 6, low 6 bits 0) ++ interleaved UV plane 4*((w+1)/2)*((h+1)/2) LE u16 (U10 <<< 6, V10 <<< 6)
semi_planar_and_packed_u16le.rgba64le: Packed R, G, B, A 8*w*h bytes (four LE u16 in [0,65535] per pixel)

deliverables: Extend PixelFormat in Core.lean with p010le, yuv422p10le, yuv444p10le, yuv420p12le, yuv422p12le, yuv444p12le, gbrp10le, rgba64le plus parse/toString/bitDepth/chromaSubsampling/frameByteSize and Plane16 / HighBitFrame helpers without breaking existing Core.lean APIs.

Exact lossless/clamped conversions in Scale.lean among yuv420p10le <-> p010le (<<6 / >>6), yuv420p10le <-> yuv422p10le <-> yuv444p10le, 10-bit <-> 12-bit, BT.709/BT.2020 YUV444P10LE <-> gbrp10le <-> rgba64le, and 10/12-bit bilinear scaling for 4:2:0/4:2:2/4:4:4.
Ordered 4x4 Bayer dithering and Floyd-Steinberg [7,3,5,1]/16 error-diffusion dithering (10/12-bit -> 8-bit and 12-bit -> 10-bit) in Scale.lean with tight AVGateSpec bounds/determinism proofs.

SMPTE ST 2084 PQ EOTF/OETF and ARIB STD-B67 HLG OETF/OOTF/EOTF + BT.2020 <-> BT.709 gamut conversion in Scale.lean, wired into real LavfiGraph vfColorspace and vfTonemap execution (replacing the placeholder execVideoEq fallback in vfTonemap).
Differential tests against ffmpeg swscale/zscale/tonemap in tests/differential/test_p1_1_pixfmt_hdr.py.

Expand AV1 sequence/frame admission and sample pipelines from 8-bit 4:2:0 to Main 10-bit (profile 0, hbd=1, 4:2:0), High 8/10-bit 4:4:4 (profile 1, subsampling 0/0), and Professional 8/10/12-bit 4:2:2 & 4:4:4 & 4:2:0 (profile 2, twelve_bit=0/1), preserving existing 8-bit Main entrypoints while adding high-bit-depth/chroma-generalized decode & encode entrypoints returning/accepting canonical raw ByteArray layouts and valid av1C config.

Bit-depth-generalize intra prediction, inter prediction/OBMC/warped/subpel, inverse & forward DCT/ADST/IDTX row/col bd clamp, deblock, CDEF (coeff_shift = bitDepth - 8), and Wiener/SGR loop restoration.

Implement full AV1 Spec §7.18.3 Film-Grain Synthesis (apply_grain): pseudo-random Gaussian sequence from grain_seed, autoregressive 64x64 luma & chroma grain block generation (ar_coeffs_y/cb/cr, ar_coeff_lag, ar_coeff_shift, grain_scale_shift), piecewise linear luma/chroma scaling LUT (num_y_points, num_cb_points, num_cr_points, cb_mult, cb_luma_mult, cb_offset, clip_to_restricted_range, chroma_scaling_from_luma), 32x32 block synthesis with overlap_flag blending, applied to output frames while keeping reference frame slots ungrained; support encoding film_grain_params OBU headers too.

Tight AVGateSpec theorems in Av1MainProofs.lean and zero-skip ffmpeg/libaom-av1 differential parity tests (Main10, High 4:4:4 10-bit, Prof 4:2:2 10/12-bit, and film-grain synthesis bit-exact/PSNR) in tests/differential/test_av1_main.py.

Expand HEVC SPS/PPS/hvcC/slice support from Main 8-bit 4:2:0 to Main 10 (profile 2, 10-bit 4:2:0) and Format Range Extensions / RExt (profile 4: Main 4:2:2 10, Main 4:4:4, Main 4:4:4 10, Main 12 / 12-bit 4:2:0/4:2:2/4:4:4), parsing sps_range_extension() and pps_range_extension() flags accurately.

Parameterize sample buffers (UInt16/Int32 planes), intra planar/DC/angular prediction (including 4:2:2 chroma angle mapping Table 8-4 and 4:4:4), 4x4..32x32 inverse/forward transforms & transform_skip with bitDepth shifts, inter luma/chroma fractional MC, deblocking (beta/tc << (bitDepth - 8)), SAO (band shift bitDepth - 5 and EO offsets), and conformance window cropping for 8/10/12-bit 4:2:0, 4:2:2, and 4:4:4; preserve all existing 8-bit Main function names/signatures while adding generalized decode/encode entrypoints and valid hvcC PTL generation.
Tight AVGateSpec theorems in HevcMainProofs.lean and fast (compact dimensions <= 64x48) zero-skip differential ffmpeg/libx265 decode & encode parity tests in tests/differential/test_hevc_main.py.
Preserve all existing public declarations in H264Entropy.lean and H264Syntax.lean imported by HevcMain.lean and LavfiGraph.lean.

Support H.264 High (100), High 10 (110), High 4:2:2 (122), and High 4:4:4 Predictive (244) in CAVLC & CABAC entropy (chroma_format_idc in {0,1,2,3}, 4:2:2 2x4 chroma DC + 8 chroma AC blocks, 4:4:4 16x16 chroma / separate_colour_plane_flag, bit_depth_luma_minus8 <= 4, bit_depth_chroma_minus8 <= 4, qpBdOffset = 6 * bit_depth_minus8, qpprime_y_zero_transform_bypass_flag, high-bit-depth I_PCM).

Parse and apply custom 4x4 & 8x8 SPS/PPS scaling matrices (seq_scaling_matrix_present_flag, pic_scaling_matrix_present_flag) with ITU-T H.264 Table 7-2 fallback rules in both inverse and forward quantization.

Bit-depth and chroma-format generalize 4x4/8x8 intra prediction, transforms (including transform_8x8_mode_flag and lossless bypass), inter MC, deblocking, DPB, and in-process decode/encode (including High10 / High422 / High444 avcC extension bytes).

Tight AVGateSpec theorems across *Proofs.lean and pixel-exact ffmpeg/libx264 differential tests (High custom scaling matrices, High 10, High 4:2:2 10-bit, High 4:4:4 Predictive 10-bit & lossless qp=0).
Preserve all existing public function signatures in Format.lean, Cli.lean, and PlanIR.lean.

Extend Cli.lean / PlanIR.lean pixel-format and HDR colorimetry flags (-pix_fmt yuv420p10le/p010le/yuv422p10le/yuv444p10le/yuv420p12le/yuv422p12le/yuv444p12le/gbrp10le/rgba64le, -color_primaries, -color_trc, -colorspace) without breaking existing standalone routing tests.

Implement HDR10 static metadata (SMPTE ST 2086 mdcv, CTA-861.3 clli, colr nclx BT.2020 PQ/HLG) demux + mux passthrough for both ISOBMFF (MP4/MOV) and Matroska/WebM (Colour, MasteringMetadata), plus high-bit-depth visual sample entry builders (avc1, hvc1/hev1, av01).

Implement Dolby Vision configuration & RPU metadata parsing, validation, and lossless passthrough in Format.lean: ISOBMFF dvcC / dvvC boxes (dv_version_major/minor, dv_profile, dv_level, rpu_present_flag, el_present_flag, bl_present_flag, dv_bl_signal_compatibility_id), Matroska BlockAdditionMapping (dvcC/dvvC), HEVC UNSPEC62 (nal_unit_type = 62) RPU NAL extraction/injection with RBSP unescaping & CRC32 validation, and AV1 METADATA_TYPE_ITUT_T35 (country_code 0xB5, provider_code 0x003B, provider_oriented_code 0x00000800) Dolby Vision RPU OBU extraction/injection.
Tight AVGateSpec theorems in Format.lean and PlanIR.lean plus differential ffprobe/ffmpeg tests in tests/differential/test_p1_1_hdr_dovi_containers.py.
Merge Tracks A-E cleanly onto campaign/p1-1-hdr-highbitdepth-20261106.

Wire end-to-end multi-stream 10/12-bit, 4:2:2, 4:4:4, p010le, gbrp10le, rgba64le, dithering, BT.2020 PQ/HLG, HDR10 mdcv/clli, Dolby Vision RPU passthrough, and AV1 film-grain synthesis across UnifiedPipeline.lean and Main.lean.
Register new proof theorems in Main.lean #print axioms and sync declaration + tight-spec counters across docs and CI.
Pass all mechanical & zero-skip differential gates, obtain independent writer=false ACCEPT on exact signed HEAD + green Linux/macOS CI, and merge PR into origin/main.
